name: TV Licence Raid
hook: Stream illicit sitcoms before the BBC detector van kicks down your door
tagline: A sweaty streamer hides in the dark watching free web videos while an inspector van creeps up the street. Cashing out closes the curtains and turns off the Wi-Fi to dodge the fine. Crashing means a high-vis inspector smashes through the drywall with a clipboard and a £1,000 penalty notice.
